unit.why: A single anecdote: during the Warka tzaddik's visit to Mogielnica, the rebbe cannot bear a young hasid who pushes into the room. He gives the man wine twice, apologizes, and the Warka rebbe later finds that the man had a bad reputation.

stories.start_quote: פ״א היה ההק׳ הצדיק מווארקא זצ״ל במאגלניצא
stories.end_quote: שכבר יצא עליו ש״ר ורינון גדול
stories.summary_en: When the Warka tzaddik visited Mogielnica, the host rebbe could not bear a young hasid unknown to him, gave him wine twice to overcome his feeling, and apologized humbly. The Warka rebbe inquired and learned that the man already had a bad name.

quotes: כאשר ראיתיו לא היה בכחי לסבול אותו כלל
ההק' ממווארקא היה יודע כי מדרגתו גדולה
tags.why: The rebbe senses the hidden sinfulness of a stranger he never knew.

quotes: התחיל לחקור ולדרוש אודות האיש ההוא
ונתוודע אליו שכבר יצא עליו ש״ר ורינון גדול
tags.why: The inquiry afterwards shows that the rebbe's aversion was justified.

quotes: ולקח צלוחית יין והושיט לאיש הזה
tags.why: The rebbe hands out wine as an act meant to overcome his aversion.

quotes: וביזה עצמו לפניו ואמר למה אני רע כ״כ
tags.why: The rebbe humbles himself and blames himself for his feeling.
The tzaddik's encounter with a man of ill repute is the core of the story.

tags.why: The setting is one rebbe hosting another rebbe and his hasidim.
